## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Edusol Learning?
No. 1, Orandi Amman Koil Street, Velachery, Chennai 600 042.

### What facilities does Edusol Learning have?
JEE Main, IIT JEE Advanced, NEET, NTSE, KVPY, JEE/NEET Foundation, IAT, INMO, CBSE, ICSE, IGCSE, Small batches, Study materials, Academic counselling, Career guidance, Mentorship.

### Which exams do you prepare students for?
CBSE, IIT-JEE Main and Advanced, NEET, NTSE, KVPY, IAT, INMO and JEE/NEET foundation.

### Are batches small?
Yes. We keep an optimal student-teacher ratio, with classes in small or appropriately sized batches.
